Exponential and logarithm maps of SO(2) and SE(2)

Source: R/lie-groups.R
lie_exp_log_2d.Rd

so2_exp(theta) returns the 2 by 2 rotation matrix; so2_log() returns the angle in \((-\pi, \pi]\). se2_exp() maps a planar twist c(vx, vy, w) to a 3 by 3 homogeneous transform, and se2_log() inverts it.

so2_exp(x)

so2_log(x, tol = 1e-06)

se2_exp(x)

se2_log(x, tol = 1e-06)

Arguments

x

Angle or twist (exp), or a matrix or planar object (log).

tol

Tolerance for validating group elements.

Value

A matrix (exp) or numeric value or vector (log).

Examples

se2_log(se2_exp(c(1, 0, pi / 2)))
#> [1]  1.000000e+00 -3.168556e-17  1.570796e+00
